preconditions.description: The number of vertices V is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.
The number of edges E is between 0 and 200000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V and 1 <= w <= 99 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (u, v, w) has vertices u and v in the range [0, V-1] and weight w in the range [1, 99].
The source vertex s and the destination vertex t are in the range [0, V-1].

postconditions.description: The output is the number of different shortest paths from s to t in the graph G.
